data.define: A moment to show your outfit and get opinions.

misuse.text: Don't ask for a 'fit check' at the gym.

data.l1_hook: Pakaian siap. Pendapat sebelum sekolah? "fit check".

native.tip: “fit check” = pemeriksaan busana. Contoh: “Quick fit check before school!”
